_comment: Giai đoạn 3 (i18n) — bảng dịch error_code sang tiếng Anh. Đợt 1: nhóm auth/token/account (ưu tiên cao nhất). Đợt 2: nhóm not_found/required tĩnh của job/company/contact (ưu tiên thứ 2 — CRUD người dùng thao tác thường xuyên). error_code KHÔNG có ở đây sẽ tự fallback về message tiếng Việt gốc từ backend (xem resolveErrorMessage() trong src/lib/api/client.ts), không bao giờ vỡ UI. Không đưa vào đây các error_code có nội dung động (UUID/giá trị nhập sai, số lần thử, danh sách hợp lệ...) vì message thật đã được backend chèn giá trị runtime vào (f-string) — dịch tĩnh sẽ làm mất thông tin đó; nhóm này để dịch sau khi có cơ chế template biến số.
token_expired: Access token is invalid or has expired — use the refresh token via POST /auth/refresh to get a new one.
session_revoked: This session is no longer valid — please log in again.
session_replaced: This account just logged in from another location — the current session has been logged out. Each account can only be used in one place at a time.
auth_server_missing_api_key: The server is not configured with an API_KEY — see .env.example.
auth_missing: Missing or invalid API key. Send it via the 'X-API-Key' header.
auth_email_not_verified: Email not verified yet — check your inbox or call POST /auth/resend-verification to resend the verification link.
auth_locked: Account temporarily locked due to too many consecutive failed logins — please try again in a few minutes.
auth_refresh_token_already_revoked: This refresh token has already been revoked — for security, all sessions for this account have been logged out. Please log in again.
auth_refresh_token_expired: Refresh token has expired — please log in again.
auth_account_inactive: This account is no longer active.
auth_email_already_registered: This email already has an account.
auth_invalid: The password reset link is invalid or has already been used.
auth_expired: The password reset link has expired — call POST /auth/forgot-password again to get a new one.
user_email_already_registered: This email already has an account.
user_role_invalid: Role must be one of: user, ss_team, admin.
user_forbidden: You can't change your own role — ask another admin to do this.
user_cannot_modify_self: You can't deactivate/activate your own account — ask another admin to do this.
contact_assigned_user_role_invalid: assigned_ss_user must be an account with role 'ss_team' or 'admin' — a contact cannot be assigned to a 'user' (student) account.
contact_not_found_in_company: No contact found under this company
contact_required: Editing an HR contact requires a 'note' explaining the reason for the change (field 'note' in the body) — other SS-team members need to know why this contact's info changed.
contact_assignee_required: Assigning/changing/unassigning the HR contact owner requires a 'note' explaining the reason — other SS-team members need to know why.
contact_still_active: This contact is still active — soft-delete it (DELETE /companies/{company_id}/contacts/{contact_id}) before hard-deleting.
